name: Suzy
source: A worker at Cookie Store. Suzy is the first person that was hired there. She has 2 older brothers and three sisters. Her father and grandmother are the family members she is the most comfortable with since her siblings all moved to different cities. Suzy's dad doesn't get a lot of time to spend with her because of his job at the oil rig.
